## Large Winch

[![Winch Large](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/c/c8/Winch_Large.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/268?cb=20190317010712)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/c/c8/Winch_Large.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190317010712)

### [Prerequisite](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Research)

Advanced Rescue Equipment

### Cost

$800

### Dimensions

4×4×3

### Introduced

[V0.1.27](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.26-27)

## Properties

| mass 100 |

| onoff Winch Up/Down |

The large winch has a cable length of 150m.

- [Small winch](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Small_winch)

- [Huge winch](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Huge_winch)

## Version history

- [V0.2.37](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.2.36-38): Fix - Added missing buoyancy data to large winch
- [V0.2.1](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.2.1): Fix - winch slip reduced
- [V0.1.32](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.30-35): Feature - Winches will now extend when pulled with enough force
- [V0.1.27](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/V0.1.26-27): Feature - Added heavy duty winch with 100m spool length
